_comment: military —— 4 英文边界 / 4 现有中文义项，一一对应无合并。这是「同词多条真义项」的干净样本：军队(名) / 军事学的(形) / 军人的(形) / 军队执行的(形)。四条判别句全部成立。

_oldSenses.reason: 对应英文 raw=0 the military forces of a nation。
对应英文 raw=1 of or relating to the study of the principles of warfare —— 军事学的/军事的。
对应英文 raw=2 characteristic of or associated with soldiers or the military —— **修饰「人」**。
对应英文 raw=3 associated with or performed by members of the armed services —— 由军队执行的。中文「适于战争的」对应得上这个意思。

senses.note: the military forces of a nation。名词义。线索：join the military / the military industrial complex。
of or relating to the study of the principles of warfare。线索：military science / military strategy。
characteristic of or associated with soldiers。**主语是人**。线索：military personnel / a military bearing。
associated with or performed by members of the armed services。**主语是行动**。线索：a military operation / military aircraft。**与 s3 分界只看主语是人还是行动。**
